subject: SOC2 supporting artifacts request — auth controls, MFA, and access reviews
messages:
From: Ava Kim <ava.kim@wellwave.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>, Procurement <procurement@wellwave.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 10:23:00 -0500
Subject: Request for SOC2 supporting artifacts for security review

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared earlier. Our security review team has a few follow-ups before we can sign off on vendor onboarding:

- Confirmation of SOC 2 audit period (we need to verify coverage for Oct–Dec 2026)
- Bridge letter if the report does not cover the current quarter
- Evidence of MFA enforcement for privileged and non-privileged accounts (screenshots or config export)
- A redacted slice of authentication/session logs covering 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31 (just auth success/fail, user id, timestamp, IP, and client)
- Recent access review artifacts showing quarterly user/role reviews and remediation notes

Can you let us know what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? Also indicate whether you can share logs via a secure link or if you require an NDA/DSA on file prior to sending anything unredacted.

Appreciate it — we aim to complete our assessment by Jan 20.

Best,
Ava
Ava Kim
Sr. InfoSec Analyst | WellWave Health
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Security Team <security@wellwave.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for SOC2 supporting artifacts for security review

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front:

- SOC 2 Type II report attached (redacted high level PDF) — audit period: 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31.
- We can provide a bridge letter that covers controls in effect since the report end date.
- We will produce MFA evidence and a redacted auth log slice for Oct–Dec 2026.
- Access review packet (Q4 2026) can be exported as PDF.

Proposed timeline: bridge letter + MFA config screenshots by EOD Jan 13; redacted auth-log slice and access-review PDFs by EOD Jan 15. If you need unredacted logs earlier, please confirm whether an NDA or a secure upload is required.

I will coordinate internally and loop in our security ops and compliance owners.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attach: redacted-soc2-typeii-2026.pdf

Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: WellWave evidence request — action items

Team — forwarding WellWave's request. Can you take the following actions?

- Neha: please pull MFA proof for both console and API users (screenshots of IdP policy, MFA enforcement list, and a short note on enforced factors). Deliver by EOD Jan 13.
- Marcus: prepare a redacted auth-log slice for 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31 with fields: timestamp, user_id (hashed), event, result, src_ip (first three octets), client_agent. Package as a password-protected archive. Deliver by EOD Jan 15.
- Marissa: export the Q4 2026 access review artifacts (review spreadsheet + remediation notes) and the internal memo confirming completion. Deliver by EOD Jan 15.

Notes on redaction: do not include full IPs, user emails, or full session payloads. If you think WellWave needs less redaction, call me before sending.

Thanks — I will tell the customer our planned delivery windows.

—Priyom
